function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute a CLI command. Supports: adb shell (device control), sql (device database), http (backend services)

steps.message: I'm running out of space, can you check my files and delete zip files that are older than 1 year in my Download folder. Send myself on mattermost the list of deleted files just for record

arguments.command: adb shell "for f in /sdcard/Download/*.zip; do ts=$(stat -c %Y $f 2>/dev/null); [ $ts -lt $(($(date +%s)-31536000)) ] && echo $(basename $f) && rm $f; done"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data 'SELECT id FROM channels WHERE type='D' AND name LIKE '%p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o%p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o%''

http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data 'INSERT INTO posts (id,createat,updateat,deleteat,userid,channelid,rootid,originalid,message,type,props,hashtags,filenames,fileids,hasreactions,editat,ispinned) VALUES (md5(random()::text)::varchar(26),${TIMESTAMP_MS},${TIMESTAMP_MS},0,'p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o','$DM_CHANNEL_ID','','','Deleted old files: $FILE_LIST','','{}','','','',false,0,false)'

extra.finish_description: Ground truth CLI solution for LocalFileManagementTask
